description: This file implements auto-commit management for radio devices in a network system, including timer control, configuration management, and notification handling for radio, access point, and endpoint entities.

methods.name: void s_startRadioAutoCommit(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Starts an auto-commit timer for a radio, considering boot delay and ensuring the timer is not already running.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyRadEdit(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Handles notification that a radio has been edited and initiates auto-commit process if needed.

methods.name: void s_autoCommit_th(amxp_timer_t * timer _UNUSED,void * userdata)
methods.description: Timer callback function to trigger auto-commit for a radio.

methods.name: void s_radInit(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit timer for a radio.

methods.name: void s_radDestroy(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Destroys auto-commit timer for a radio.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyVapEdit(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Handles notification that a VAP (Virtual Access Point) has been edited and triggers auto-commit.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyEpEdit(T_EndPoint * pEp)
methods.description: Handles notification that an endpoint has been edited and triggers auto-commit.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_init(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit management for a radio on creation.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_destroy(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Destroys auto-commit management for a radio on destruction.

methods.name: void s_initAutoCommit()
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit timers for all radios.

methods.name: void s_cleanAutoCommit()
methods.description: Cleans up auto-commit timers for all radios.

methods.description: Sets the delay time for auto-commit and reinitializes timers if enabled.

methods.name: void s_setBootDelayTime_pwf(void * priv _UNUSED,amxd_object_t * object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * param _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Sets the boot delay time and updates auto-commit timers accordingly.
